payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): Why 128-Byte Swizzling is Mandatory on Blackwell

problem.statement: Nsight Compute command to check shared memory bank conflicts -- Why 128-Byte Swizzling is Mandatory on Blackwell

payload.technique: Why 128-Byte Swizzling is Mandatory on Blackwell
payload.what: Shared memory has 32 banks, each 4 bytes wide (128 bytes total per bank cycle). When a warp accesses a matrix stored in row-major layout, threads in the same warp reading elements from consecutive rows in the same column hit the same bank, causing a 32-way bank conflict.
payload.when: Shared memory has 32 banks, each 4 bytes wide (128 bytes total per bank cycle).

implementation.snippet:
```
Naive (no swizzle):   255 TFLOPS  (17% of cuBLAS)
128B swizzle applied: 695 TFLOPS  (46% of cuBLAS)
                      ---- 2.7x improvement from swizzling alone ----
```
